history.summary: A 667 sqft freehold 1BR in D14 priced at $1258 PSF — roughly 16% below the project's own URA median of $1499 PSF — making it the cheapest entry in the batch on a relative-value basis. The 667 sqft footprint is large for a 1BR (likely a 1+study or jumbo one-bedder), which dampens per-sqft cheapness somewhat but keeps the absolute quantum under $840k.
history.rating_rationale: $1258 PSF vs $1499 URA median is a genuine ~16% discount on a freehold near Aljunied MRT, with a low sub-$840k quantum that keeps the buyer pool deep. URA resale CAGR ~4.0% on 12 txns is moderate-confidence but consistent with RCR-adjacent D14. Aljunied/Paya Lebar benefits from the Paya Lebar Central transformation and airbase relocation catalyst. Highest score_1000 (887) and on-frontier.

history.summary: Project-level cheapness looks real - $1,257 psf is the floor of the live $1,258-$1,638 range and ~16% under the recent ~$1,499 transacted average - but the same-size cohort is empty (psf_cohort_txns=0), the 667 sqft 'beds:1' is a mismatch, and La Fleur sits squarely in the Geylang FH cohort that media has flagged for 'more losses than gains' and slow growth. Genuine value, but capped exit upside keeps it Neutral.
history.rating_rationale: Listing $838,888 / 667 sqft = $1,257 psf. Web confirms La Fleur (FH, 2014, 58 units, Lorong 26 Geylang) current PSF range $1,258-$1,638 and recent-12mo transactions averaging ~$1,499 psf (high $1,516 in Dec 2024), with rental yield ~4.6%. So $1,257 is at the bottom of the live range and a real discount to recent prints, supporting the -33.1% age-adj signal at project level. But psf_cohort_txns=0 means no same-size comp behind the -14.2% cohort figure; the 667 sqft 'beds:1' (very_low_psf + likely a large 1BR/2BR) suggests a mislabel; and an EdgeProp/Yahoo spotlight specifically flagged Geylang freehold condos (including La Fleur's peers) for more losses than gains, with D14 FH ~$1,516 psf trailing East ~$1,706 and islandwide ~$1,953 - structural slow growth and thin liquidity in a 58-unit project.
